raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, and related parts should re-verify ECCN classification and license requirements, confirm US HTS alignment for the 9302/9303 tariff lines, and re-screen customers and consignees against BIS Entity List and restricted party lists. Section 301 tariff exposure and destination-country import controls (e.g., EU Firearms Directive, ASEAN transshipment rules) still apply, so maintain end-use/end-user documentation and origin records for each shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销拜登时期的民用枪械出口规则，放宽民用枪械及弹药在《出口管理条例》下的许可与分类处理。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪及相关零部件的企业应重新核实ECCN分类与许可要求，确认9302/9303税号与美国HTS的对应关系，并对客户及收货人重新进行BIS实体清单和受限方筛查。第301条关税风险及目的国进口管制（如欧盟武器指令、东盟转运规则）仍然适用，须为每批货物保留最终用途/最终用户证明及原产地记录。

checklist.desc: Confirm whether civilian firearms, parts, and ammunition now fall under EAR controls or move to ITAR/Commerce licensing exemptions after the rule rescission; document the classification basis.
Map each product to the correct 10-digit HTS line (9302.00, 9303.20, 9303.30) and cross-check against Section 301 lists and applicable additional duties.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Run denied party, Entity List, and end-user screening for all consignees and intermediaries; retain screening records and end-use statements.
Check License Requirements and Country Chart for the destination; obtain BIS license or license exception documentation before shipment where required.
Verify destination-country firearms import permits and transit/transshipment rules (e.g., EU Firearms Directive, ASEAN Form E/RCEP origin) to avoid diversion risk.
Confirm destination safety markings, serialization, and any environmental/lead-content restrictions for ammunition and firearm components.
